# Handle outside services safely

Coding rule · `W12`

Wrap third-party calls (Google, Gemini/Claude, Apollo, Cognism, FullEnrich, HubSpot, Salesforce, Stripe, PayPal, RevenueCat) in try/catch; report via app('sentry')->captureException($e); return W2 failure; no empty catch

Part of [[Hubs/Coding rules|Coding rules]].
